Design Lab

Methodology Design Lab — 60-Page Workbook

Sixty structured exercises to design, test, and refine your original method and certification pathway.

This workbook is a build document. Prioritize specificity over polish and revision over perfection.

Instructions

  • Complete all exercises in order.
  • Use Module 11 as your conceptual anchor.
  • Add evidence tier labels whenever you make outcome claims.
  • Revisit exercises 19 to 36 after every pilot class.
